dedupe_keys.name: geomagnetic storm forecast model developed by korea astronomy and space science institute

description: The KASI geomagnetic-storm model estimates storm strength and probability from early CME observations. It can combine a shock-arrival calculation with its empirical Dst relationships. The resource is documented by KASI. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere, Geospace; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Early warning depends on the quality of initial event parameters and does not establish deterministic storm timing. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
